posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
TakeWalker:

I love Adam’s ability to capture period comic book art. That cover is fantastic! Tachyon’s haircut is so bad and I love it! Nothing like a robot with a giant light bulb for a head, right?

If anything, it’s a little too good, IMO. Old covers like that always had at least one character that looked janky. Legacy’s getting there (he looks way too old) but not quite. Although I love Bunker’s almost featureless body. And ugh, Tachyon wearing way too much makeup for absolutely no reason, very period.

posts.cooked:
They’re making an intentionally underwhelming story, and in the middle they tell that AMAZING story about Christopher’s great grandmother and the books! I want an entire episode about THAT!

I also think Wraith’s boyfriend should be named Charles Churchill. Because, basically, classic comics always alliterate.

I like that Adam pronounces “curator” as if it was El Curator from the Telenovelaverse.

Madame Mittermaier was probably a “gypsy”, in the parlance of the time, and then Aislin Allen was Irish…I wonder what other groups of former “undesirables” might be represented in the Glamour line. Is Aminia Twain perhaps Polish?

I officially endorse Young Legacy as being the “father” of Paul Parsons the 9th whose “mother” was Tempest.

I think Setback absolutely would trip and shatter a glass and get a bunch of cuts. Pretty definitely not lethally so.

I don’t recall the VAN-dals having a manatee as their airbrush, because I thought it had already been decided that their van art was Citizen Dawn riding a velocitaptor and like wielding a glowing axe shaped like a guitar or something. Wasn’t that established first? Stupid retcon dugong!
